General Characters.Habitat: Aquatic, mostly marine except few freshwater forms like Hydra
General Characters.Habit: Sessile or free swimming, Solitary or Colonial
General Characters.Symmetry: Radial symmetry except Sea anemone which is Biradial symmetrical.

Body wall.__p: Consists of 2 cellular layers surrounding the Mesogloea
Mesogloea: Ranges from a thin, noncellular basal lamina to thick, fibrous, jelly-like, connective tissue with or without mesenchymal cells.

Gastrovascular cavity/ Coelenteron: This cavity serves as gut (for digestion of food) and as circulatory system (for circulation of digested body).
Opens to outside at one end of body to form a mouth.
Mouth serves both in ingestion and egestion.

Polymorphism.__p: The occurrence of structurally and functionally different types of individuals, called zooids, within the same organism during its life history is called Polymorphism.

Nematocyst.Cnidocyte/ Cnidoblast: It is cell of cnidarians containing cnide.
Cnide: Cnide are cellular organelles of cnidocyte.
It is capable of eversion from cnidocyte.
It is of 3 types of which one type is Nematocyst.

Locomotion: Brought about by smooth muscle fibres.
Nervous system: Nervous system is a collection of multipolar and bipolar nerve cells forming an irregular net or plexus.

Sexual methods: Indirect development by formation of Planula larva.

Metagenesis/ Alternation of generation.__p: Alternation of polypoid and medusoid generation occurs.
